owner: The owner named a par-keys case; the held-Cmd cases sit in par-macshell J0.19 (checks/parity/par-macshell.py). Accept that place, or ask for them in par-keys.
notes: Built on lane/gap-keys: four rig doors in Sources/Features/MacShell/MacShellFeature.swift (macshell.hint.hold-by-flags, release-by-flags, window-resign, event-without-cmd) calling MacHintMonitor.simulateHold/simulateRelease/simulateWindowResign/simulateEventWithoutCommand (MacHintOverlay.swift, before cancel()). J0.19 now has cases for all four exits: caps-hide-when-the-app-resigns-active, caps-hide-when-the-app-returns-without-cmd (existing), caps-hide-when-cmd-comes-up-in-the-flags, caps-hide-when-a-window-resigns-key, caps-hide-on-an-event-without-cmd. Two corrections to the old gap text: (1) a key-down always cancels (event(): joined), so only a key-UP or scroll without Cmd proves the flag-less exit: the door sends a key-up with no flags through NSApp.sendEvent after the hold installed the key monitor; (2) macshell.hint.release calls holdEnded directly, so the old mutant 3 (Cmd-up branch emptied) was not red on J0.12: it is now judged by caps-hide-when-cmd-comes-up-in-the-flags (flagsChanged route). Limit: the window-resign door runs focusLost(), the handler didResignKey runs; the notification registration itself (MacHintOverlay.swift didResignKey observer) is not exercised on the hidden rig. Unrun: the lead compiles and runs par-macshell.
